historical_commentary.text: 4D Open as a distinct plug-in is obsolete; modern 4D applications would use ORDA remote datastores or REST APIs to update records on a remote 4D Server, both of which handle differing/unknown structures more gracefully than the identical-structure assumption made in this note.
related_updates: ORDA remote datastores and REST APIs have superseded the 4D Open plug-in for remote record CRUD operations
